title: MCP Gateway config schema v13 (16.0, proposal until 16.0.0-rc.1)
description: Config schema v13 = schema v12 with the 16.0 rules: module plugins take only `runtime`, an inline module plugin needs `allowInline: true`, `/mcp` no longer accepts revision 2024-11-05. 16.x also reads v12 files (in-memory, reported as `schema.v12`); 14.x / 15.x refuse v13. See docs/migrating-to-v16.md.

edgeAutonomy.description: Edge autonomy (10.7; GA in 14.6): local decisions while an upstream is unreachable, offline permission boundaries (high-risk calls denied offline by default), sealed queue with expiry, fenced reconcile honouring revocations. See docs/guides/edge-autonomy.md.

dir.description: Persist the sealed queue, last-good cache and intent log here (0700; files 0600). Relative to the config file.

rules.description: First match on "server/tool" decides what a call does while its server is disconnected.

policies.description: NEW in 14.6: declared offline policy per server / tool (first match on "server/tool").

offline.description: allow: may be answered / queued offline whatever its risk; deny: never; unset: by risk (highRisk).

risk.description: Declared risk; replaces the classifier (annotations, tool-name heuristics).

idempotent.description: Safe to repeat: an in-doubt replay is resent with the same idempotency key.

conflictKey.description: Argument names identifying the record written; concurrent offline writes by different clients go to review.

highRisk.description: NEW in 14.6 (behaviour change): offline handling of high / critical risk calls (writes, deletes, payments, non-idempotent) that no policy allows.

onExpiry.description: An expired call is never replayed: parked for review, or dropped.

idempotencyArg.description: Argument carrying the idempotency key (the client's own, else the outbox id).

leaseMs.description: NEW in 14.6: reconcile lease; a crashed reconciler is taken over after this (fencing epoch).

requireFreshRevocations.description: NEW in 14.6: replay only after revocation authorities (multi-region) are confirmed fresh since reconnect.

seal.description: NEW in 14.6: AES-256-GCM sealing of the persisted queue / cache.

keyEnv.description: Environment variable holding a 32-byte key (base64 or hex); default: a generated <dir>/.seal.key (0600).

regions.description: Multi-region active-active (5.2). 14.5 adds explicit consistency boundaries: replicated revocations, bounded staleness (fail closed), version vectors, clock-skew bounds. See docs/guides/multi-region.md.

downAfter.description: consecutive failed syncs before a peer is down

consistency.description: NEW in 14.5: bounded staleness and clock-skew bounds

maxStalenessMs.description: a region is fresh while every peer synced within this window (default max(30000, 3 × syncIntervalMs); at least 2 × syncIntervalMs)

maxClockSkewMs.description: replicated writes stamped further ahead are rejected

onStale.description: deny = refuse tool calls while not fresh (fail closed, -32027)

taskGraphs.description: Task graphs (10.7). 14.4 adds durable execution: resume after restart, idempotency keys, DLQ, approval resume. See docs/guides/durable-tasks.md.

dir.description: checkpoint directory (relative to the config file)

backend.description: auto: the gateway store when it is not memory, else dir, else memory

resumeOnStart.description: continue runs left in flight (lease lapsed) from their last committed step

leaseMs.description: heartbeat lease of an executing gateway

idempotencyTtlSeconds.description: how long a submission idempotency key is remembered

retentionHours.description: NEW in 14.9: delete finished runs (succeeded, failed, cancelled, compensated) this long after they ended; 0 = keep forever

clients.description: NEW in 14.4 (durable): any authenticated client may start it under /api/v1/features/task-graphs

idempotent.description: NEW in 14.4: safe to execute again after a crash between call and commit

idempotencyArg.description: NEW in 14.4: argument that receives the stable per-call key <runId>:<node> (implies repeat-safe)

approval.description: NEW in 14.4 (durable): wait for human approval before the node runs

controlPlane.$comment: unchanged from schema v11 (validated by the runtime schema) except the optional `rollout` (14.1), `gitops` (14.7) and `console` (14.8)

console.description: NEW in 14.8 (optional): operations console — /api/v1/admin/ops/* and the dashboard Operations page. See docs/guides/operations-console.md.

viewers.description: Client id globs (key:oncall) with read-only console access.

explainDenials.description: Add the denial explanation (with the config path) to refused REST tool calls made by operators; other clients never get it.

tenantViewers.description: NEW in 15.1 (optional): tenant members (role owner / admin / viewer) read the call traces, lineage and cost rollup (GET /admin/ops/costs) of their own tenants, and nothing else on the console.

token.description: Data plane: an operator API key of the control plane. ${VAR} references are expanded; an unset variable is a config error (14.7, MGW-2026-019).

gitops.description: NEW in 14.7 (optional; control plane or role all): GitOps — signed release manifests (ed25519), required approvals per environment, enforcement, drift detection. See docs/guides/gitops.md.

environment.description: the environment this gateway runs (bundles and manifests for another environment are refused)

enforce.description: only signed, sufficiently approved releases may change the config; PUT /admin/config and /admin/reload answer 409

trustedKeys.description: release signing keys (enforce: true needs at least one)

name.description: the person or bot holding the key; approvals count once per name and never for the author

publicKey.description: ed25519:<base64 raw key> (mcp-gateway gitops keygen) or an SPKI PEM

requiredApprovals.description: approvals a release needs: a number, or per environment with "*" as fallback (default: 2 for prod / production, else 0)

maxManifestAgeSeconds.description: manifests older than this are refused

recordFile.description: persist the applied release (replay protection and drift baseline across restarts); relative to the config file

rollout.description: NEW in 14.1 (optional; control plane only): how config generations roll out to data planes. See docs/guides/cluster-rollout.md.

canary.description: canary size: a data-plane count or a percentage of the known data planes (strategy canary needs one)

module.description: ES module path (relative to the config file) or package name

isolation.description: WASM components only: sandbox per tenant | client | shared (v13: module plugins use `runtime`)

runtime.description: module plugins: where the plugin runs (worker is the default since 15.0); inline needs `allowInline: true`

failure.description: NEW in 14.3 (module plugins): what a failed hook does

timeoutMs.description: inline module plugins: per hook call

maxFailures.description: NEW in 14.3 (module plugins): circuit breaker threshold

permissions.description: NEW in 14.3 (module plugins): declared capabilities; network / env / fs need runtime worker or process

allowInline.description: NEW in v13: explicit opt-in for a module plugin with `runtime: inline` (runs in the gateway process)

tenancy.description: NEW in 14.2 (optional): centralized tenant isolation. Absent = pre-14.2 behaviour. See docs/guides/tenant-isolation.md.

isolation.description: With isolation on, each server belongs to the first tenant (config order) whose `servers` globs match it; other tenants reach it only through a grant.

crossTenant.description: deny: cross-tenant access only through grants; audit: allowed as before, every crossing recorded
